file_insights.changes: Created new Django migration file with 11 database index operations
key_observations: Adds indexes to 3 models: PurchaseOrder, PurchaseRequest, Receiving
Includes dependencies on inventory and materials app migrations
PurchaseRequest: 4 indexes added (status, request_date, is_active, composite status+is_active)
PurchaseOrder: 4 indexes added (status, order_date, is_active, composite status+is_active)
Indexes follow consistent naming pattern and field selection strategy

patterns_discovered.description: All models include indexes on status, active flag, and a date field relevant to the model, plus a composite index on status+is_active
patterns_discovered.significance: Indicates planned performance optimization for filtering by status, date range queries, and active record filtering

patterns_discovered.pattern: Status and Active Flag Composite Indexing
patterns_discovered.description: Both PurchaseOrder and PurchaseRequest include a composite index on [status, is_active] fields
patterns_discovered.significance: Suggests common query patterns filtering by both status and active state simultaneously

patterns_discovered.description: Each model indexes its primary date field: request_date for PurchaseRequest, order_date for PurchaseOrder, receiving_date for Receiving
patterns_discovered.significance: Indicates date-based filtering and sorting are critical query patterns in the purchasing workflow

patterns_discovered.description: Indexes defined in model Meta class rather than in migration, allowing Django to auto-generate migration
patterns_discovered.significance: Follows Django best practice of defining schema in models with migrations auto-generated

gotchas_discovered.description: Migration depends on 'inventory' app's '0002_add_indexes' migration, creating tight coupling between apps
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure inventory app migrations are applied before purchasing migrations in deployment order

gotchas_discovered.description: Index names use truncated hash suffixes (e.g., 04b4e7, 09a604) which could theoretically collide across migrations
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Django's migration system handles this, but names should be verified for uniqueness in database

gotchas_discovered.description: Receiving model does not include the status+is_active composite index that exists on other two models
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify if Receiving queries don't use that filter combination, or add index for consistency

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No Index on Foreign Key Fields
gotchas_discovered.description: Migration does not explicitly index foreign key fields that may be used in joins or filtering
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider adding indexes on supplier_id, material_id, and purchase_order_id fields if they're used in WHERE clauses

approach_outcome.session_result: Migration successfully created and model definitions updated

execution_details.implementation_strategy: Declarative index definition in model Meta classes with auto-generated migration

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding indexes to foreign key fields (supplier_id, material_id, purchase_order_id) if they're frequently used in WHERE clauses or JOIN operations
recommendations.rationale: Would improve join performance and filter efficiency on related records

recommendations.recommendation: Add status+is_active composite index to Receiving model to match pattern in other models
recommendations.rationale: Ensures consistency in indexing strategy across all purchasing models

recommendations.recommendation: Document the rationale behind index field selection in model docstrings or comments
recommendations.rationale: Future developers will understand why these specific fields were indexed

recommendations.recommendation: Run EXPLAIN queries on common purchasing operations to verify indexes are being utilized
recommendations.rationale: Validate that the indexes actually improve query performance before deploying to production

recommendations.recommendation: Monitor slow query logs post-deployment to identify if additional indexes are needed
recommendations.rationale: Real-world usage patterns may reveal additional high-impact optimization opportunities
